method: Manual visual reading of sex and age in the 1950 Cuervo ED 10-6 schedules. Entries follow the named-row inventory in the September 17 person-count file. Infants with a birth month are coded age 0; no inference from names. This is a research transcription, not an official tabulation.
notes: Sheet 2 line 26 is a birth-month entry, coded under 1 (0).
Sheet 2 line 27 has a corrected age, read as 60.
Sheet 3 lines 22, 23 and 29 rechecked in enlarged crop: 62, 12 and 6 respectively.
Sheet 5 line 2 age rechecked in a focused crop: 37.
Sheet 6 line 12 is recorded as M in the sex column despite wife in the relationship column; retained as written, not inferred from the name or relationship.
Sheet 7 line 13 is crossed through and rewritten on the same named row; included under the existing 210-person inventory.
Sheet 4 line 28 and sheet 6 line 27 are birth-month entries, coded age 0.
